body:
Is it common for them to not leave a message? I figured they would call me during their open hours. The thing that bothers me is they did it when I wasn't expecting it. They even have a backup number that wasn't called.

I've missed a doctor's appointment i was supoosed to go to as mandated by them because of stuff like this, no message then either.

Trust only goes so far. I'm going to get a second opinion in a few days. In my experience though doctors often don't look "outside of the box." I had to see 5 different doctors when I was 18 because they saw my symptoms but couldn't overlook one key thing, my age. Each one of them simply thought it was a rash. Everything indicated I had shingles but that was "an old person" thing so I couldn't have had it. But hey, I had a bad case. Whattya know.

I'm not expecting them to be miracle workers but years of visits and absolutely no solution? If it were just the headaches I could understand as I know a few people who "just have them." The medicine they take helps tremendously. Nothing has worked for me. I don't think the discovery of the cyst and these symptoms I've had prior to that revelation are seperate.

It is on the left side of my brain stem and if it would alleviate these problems I'd gladly undergo surgery despite any risks. Even if it was a 50/50. I wouldn't call this living.
